one_liner.zh: 本周加密与美股期货同向 risk-on：BTC 窗口 +4.1% 高位震荡，NQ 更强；杠杆侧出现上涨段清算挤压且 OI 明显回落，实现波动仍高而期末 IV 相对 RV 折价，美现货 BTC ETF 合计净流入 +23.86 亿美金、通道强流入。
one_liner.en: Crypto and US equity futures moved in risk-on sync: BTC +4.1% in high-level chop, NQ stronger; leverage showed upside liquidation squeeze with clear OI drop, realized vol stayed high while end-IV discounted to RV, and US spot BTC ETFs booked +2.39B net inflow (strong-inflow channel).

zh: BTC ETF 周净流 +23.86 亿美金

risk.zh: 高实现波动叠加 OI 收缩与清算峰，若拥挤回潮或传统风险偏好骤转，震荡中枢可能被快速刺穿；IV 折价并不自动等于保护充足；杠杆读法：盯拥挤线（费率路径+OI）与出清线（2026-09-21 峰是否双高、次日是否退烧）。
risk.en: High realized vol plus OI contraction and a liquidation peak leave the chop range vulnerable if crowding returns or TradFi risk appetite flips; an IV discount is not automatic protection; Leverage read: crowding (funding path+OI) and flush (2026-09-21 peak dual-high? next-day cool-down?).

watch.zh: 盯现货 ETF 强流入能否延续、OI/资金费率是否止跌回升，以及 IV-RV 折价是否收窄。
watch.en: Watch whether strong ETF inflows persist, whether OI/funding stop falling and rebound, and whether the IV-RV discount narrows.

leverage.zh: 清算驱动（上涨段挤压迹象）

vol_premium.zh: 期权偏便宜（IV 相对 RV 折价）

compare.zh: BTC +4.1% 与 NQ +4.3%、ES +1.9% 同向，黄金 -2.3%、美元与美债收益率偏强，刻画的是「风险资产共振、避险与利率端并不配合」的一周，而非单一币种独自暴走。
compare.en: BTC’s +4.1% aligned with NQ +4.3% and ES +1.9% while gold fell 2.3% and the dollar and yields firmed—risk assets resonated together, hedges and rates did not play along, rather than a lone crypto breakout.

path.zh: 路径标签为高位震荡：窗口收益为正但未给出干净趋势延伸，更像在既有高位区间内消化杠杆与波动，而不是单边趋势周。
path.en: Path label is high-level chop: positive window return without a clean trend extension—more digestion of leverage and vol inside an elevated range than a one-way trend week.

leverage.zh:
标签：清算驱动（上涨段挤压迹象）。
① 拥挤线（OI + 资金费率年化）：周初约 +4.60%/yr → 期末约 +2.23%/yr，租金全周降温；OI 周变约 -12.67%（107797 → 94135），库存周内回落，偏去杠杆。
② 出清线（OI + 清算）：主峰日 09-21（2026-09-21）；峰值约 3.41× 周内中位清算量；价格同日约 +6.7%；当日 OI 约 109182；与 OI 日高同日（清算∥OI 双高）；峰值日 OI 较前一日上升，偏改仓/挤压结构而非单纯慢速拆仓。次日 2026-09-22：OI 自峰值日回落至约 106713、funding 年化约 +1.12%/yr、价格约 -0.5%。 side 语义未核验，此处只并陈结构，不判多空谁爆。
③ 量旁证（永续成交额=活跃度）：周合计约 902.24 亿美金，环比约 +8.0%，活跃度中性；量侧用于核对热闹程度，不拆多空。
收句：拥挤线路径 + 出清线「峰值双高/事件尖峰」共同支撑「清算驱动（上涨段挤压迹象）」；禁止把清算/OI/funding 写成涨跌原因。 side 语义未核验，只并陈结构。
leverage.en:
Label: liquidation_driven_squeeze.
① Crowding (OI + funding ann.): ~+4.60%/yr → ~+2.23%/yr — rent cooled over the week; OI week change ~-12.67% (107797 → 94135), inventory down on the week — lean deleveraging.
② Flush (OI + liquidations): peak day 2026-09-21; peak ~3.41× median liq qty; price that day ~+6.7%; OI that day ~109182; same day as OI week-high (liq∥OI dual-high); OI up vs prior day — reposition/squeeze structure more than slow unwind. Next day 2026-09-22: OI eased to ~106713; funding ~+1.12%/yr; price ~-0.5%. Side semantics unverified — structure only, no long/short blame.
③ Volume side (perp turnover = activity): week sum ~90.22B, WoW ~+8.0%, activity normal; activity only, not long/short.
Close: lines ①–③ check whether label “liquidation_driven_squeeze” holds; do not write liq/OI/funding as the cause of price.

etf.zh: 美现货 BTC ETF 合计净申赎约 +23.86 亿美金（强流入；5 个净流入日、0 个净流出日），ETH 合计约 +6.90 亿美金；累计口径仍处高位。并陈 Binance 现货成交额周合计约 110.08 亿美金、环比约 +29.8%（偏热），永续约 902.24 亿、环比约 +8%——总量热闹与净申赎同屏，不把流入写成涨跌原因，也不与杠杆成交加总。
etf.en: US spot BTC ETFs net ~+2.39B (strong inflow; 5 inflow days, 0 outflow), ETH ~+689.8M; cumulative stays elevated. Alongside, Binance spot turnover ~11.01B on the week (~+29.8% WoW, hot) and perp ~90.22B (~+8% WoW)—activity heat and net creations on the same screen, without welding flows to the week’s return or summing them with leverage volume.

spot_volume.zh: Binance 现货成交额（turnover 美金，程序周合计）：本周 110.08 亿美金，相对上完整周 +29.8%（活跃度「偏热」；上周约 84.82 亿美金）。峰值日 2026-09-21（27.03 亿美金）。这是交易所现货「换手热闹程度」，与 ETF 净申赎同属现货世界、只并陈；对照永续周成交额 902.24 亿美金——两者量级不同，**禁止相加**，也**不能**拆多空。
spot_volume.en: Binance spot turnover (USD, program week sum): this week 11.01B, vs prior full week +29.8% (activity “hot”; prior ~8.48B). Peak day 2026-09-21 (2.70B). Spot tape busyness beside ETF net flow — same spot world, no sum with perp (90.22B); not a long/short split.

vol_teach.zh: 高 RV 意味着过去窗口价格路径已经很「费」，IV 折价则表示期权市价对未来波动的报价低于刚走过的实现波动——常见于冲击过后定价尚未跟上，或供给愿意在高 RV 背景下仍卖便宜波动。
vol_teach.en: High RV means the recent path already burned a lot of vol; an IV discount means options are pricing future vol below that just-realized path—often after a shock before pricing catches up, or when supply is still willing to sell vol cheap against elevated RV.

vol_week.zh: BTC 实现波动年化约 52.3%，仍处高实现波动带；期末 Deribit IV 约 35.1%，IV-RV 价差约 -17.2 个百分点，期权相对 RV 偏便宜。
vol_week.en: BTC realized vol ~52.3% ann., still in the high-RV band; end Deribit IV ~35.1%, IV-RV spread ~-17.2 pp, options cheap versus RV.

vol_combo.zh: 高实现波动 + IV 相对折价 + 高位震荡：波动已经兑现一截，但期权层尚未给出对称的贵价保护，组合上更像「路径已吵、保费仍克制」。
vol_combo.en: High RV + IV discount + high chop: a slice of vol already realized while the options layer has not marked protection symmetrically rich—path noisy, premia still restrained.

vol_price_iv.zh: 价格周线收正、IV 期末低于 RV，说明上涨并未同步推高期权隐含；ETH 期末 IV 约 49.0% 对自身 RV 约 42.9% 则略偏贵，BTC/ETH 波动定价并不完全同调。
vol_price_iv.en: Positive price week with end-IV below RV shows the advance did not lift implieds in lockstep; ETH end-IV ~49.0% vs its RV ~42.9% is mildly rich, so BTC/ETH vol pricing is not fully aligned.

vol_vix.zh: VIX 窗口约 +0.4%，几乎走平，与 BTC 高 RV、IV 折价形成对照：传统恐慌指标平静，加密实现波动仍高。
vol_vix.en: VIX ~+0.4% on the bracket, nearly flat—contrasting BTC’s high RV and IV discount: TradFi fear gauge calm while crypto realized vol stayed elevated.

what.zh: 美股隐含波动指数 VIX

vs_crypto.zh: VIX 中低位小动通常解释不了币的大涨跌；与上一节加密 IV 只做角色对照。
vs_crypto.en: Small VIX moves rarely explain big crypto moves; role-parallel to crypto IV only.

vs_crypto.zh: 美元走强时对风险资产偏逆风。
vs_crypto.en: Stronger USD is often a headwind for risk assets.

vs_crypto.zh: 利率与币涨跌若相反，则不是单纯降息交易。
vs_crypto.en: If yields move opposite crypto, this is not a pure cut-trade story.

vs_crypto.zh: 与币关系需看结构，不宜硬套。
vs_crypto.en: Link to crypto is structural—not mechanical.

tradfi_summary.zh: 美股期货风险偏好偏多（NQ 明显强于 ES），VIX 近乎不动，DXY 小涨、美债收益率升约 18.6 bp、黄金回落，整体是风险资产同向、利率与美元偏紧、避险走弱的括号周，与加密「同向 risk-on」标签一致。
tradfi_summary.en: US equity futures leaned risk-on (NQ clearly ahead of ES), VIX barely moved, DXY edged up, 10Y yield +~18.6 bp, gold softened—risk assets together, rates/dollar firmer, hedges weaker—matching the crypto risk-on-sync label.

three_conclusions.zh: 加密与 NQ/ES 同向 risk-on，但黄金走弱、收益率上行，说明本周共振来自风险偏好而非全面流动性宽松叙事。
three_conclusions.en: Crypto moved risk-on with NQ/ES while gold weakened and yields rose—the sync was risk appetite, not a broad easy-liquidity story.

three_conclusions.zh: 上涨段清算挤压与 OI 约 -12.7% 并陈，杠杆更像出清痕迹；永续量正常、现货成交偏热，和 ETF 强流入同屏但不断言因果。
three_conclusions.en: Upside liquidation squeeze alongside ~-12.7% OI reads as flush traces; perp activity normal and spot turnover hot sit beside strong ETF inflow without causal welding.

three_conclusions.zh: 高 RV 对照期末 IV 折价约 17 个百分点，波动已经走出来一截而期权仍偏便宜，是本周波动结构的核心矛盾。
three_conclusions.en: High RV versus an ~17 pp end-IV discount is the core vol tension: a slice of vol already realized while options stayed relatively cheap.

text.en: Next check: whether US spot BTC ETF net stays multi-day inflow and the channel remains strong-inflow.

watch_items.rationale_zh: 本周净流从近乎持平跃至 +23.86 亿且全日流入，是最大的通道变量，需看是否续航而非单周脉冲。

text.zh: 下期核对：BTC OI 周变是否止跌、资金费率年化是否仍温和或重新抬升。
text.en: Next check: whether BTC OI weekly change stops falling and funding ann. stays mild or re-lifts.

watch_items.rationale_zh: 本周 OI 大幅回落叠加上涨挤压，若费率与 OI 重新抬头，拥挤叙事会切换。

text.zh: 下期核对：IV-RV 折价是否收窄（IV 是否追上高 RV）或 RV 自身是否回落。
text.en: Next check: whether the IV-RV discount narrows (IV catching high RV) or RV itself cools.

watch_items.rationale_zh: 高实现波动与期权偏便宜是本周结构矛盾，收窄或持续直接改变波动叙事。

matched.zh: 高位震荡叠加清算挤压后的 OI 回落与温和费率，价格路径更利于均值回归类框架去捕捉区间内的往返，而非假设趋势已重新单边打开；故与 mean_reversion 标签匹配。
matched.en: High chop after a liquidation squeeze, with OI down and mild funding, favors mean-reversion frames that trade range round-trips over assuming a fresh one-way trend—hence the match to mean_reversion.

mismatched.zh: 趋势跟随缺少干净突破延伸的确认；波动收割在高 RV 且 IV 折价时，卖出波动的赔率与缓冲并不理想，故 trend_following 与 vol_harvest 均不匹配。
mismatched.en: Trend-following lacks clean breakout extension; vol-harvest faces poor odds and buffer when RV is high and IV is discounted—so both trend_following and vol_harvest mismatch.

note.en: Note: high realized vol or liquidation spike — trend backdrop can still be a rough path.

why.zh: 趋势偏震荡/磨盘（高位震荡），更接近区间来回而非单边趋势条件。 但高波宽幅震荡时，回归类也会很颠。
why.en: Trend reads choppy/grind (chop_high); closer to range-bound than one-way trend. Wide high-vol chop is still rough for reversion-style paths.
